title: ID0426497-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / R7 170002239]-Hamina OCPP door open status missing
description:
When charger door (dispenser dooer?) suddenly opened, charger only sent errorcode “SafetyRelay_QA26” but further errorcode “DoorPositionSwitch_BG3_BG4” or dispenser door open-message was missing.
R&D Ticket created:
https://jira.si.siemens.cloud/browse/EVC3-9513
2/Jun - No answer yet from R&D

additional_info.subject: ID0426497-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / R7 170002239]-Hamina OCPP door open status missing CRM:00315002680
additional_info.body:
Hi Markus,
Yesterday I was not able to use the SID for the tests but we will do it today.
Yesterday I checked via AWS and apparently we are not receiving the Dispenser one:
This is the timestamp you provided to me, exactly at this time we get the error flag but not the OCPP StatusNotification.
It seems that according to the schematic, both error flags of the QA26 and Dispenser door are reported at the “same” time, see here:
As you can see, when we open the door, the error flag is raised but also open the circuit to the main charger where it leads to QA26.
Now what we need to understand is why this error flag is triggered first. For example, when we do a reboot, we don't send all the errors to OCPP except PerformingCollaboratedReboot. So my assumption is that when we get dispenser door opened, he prioritizes QA26 and as such it doesn't send it.
After our tests, I will propose to create a R&D ticket to understand.
Best regards,
Francisco

Hello Markus,
We have reported the case to R&D already. There is a Rework related to OCPP vender codes already in place to better define what would be the necessary information to send via OCPP, including better management of priority messages.
Most probably this will only take effect on v9 but without confirmation yet.
Since from service there is no task pending here, I will proceed to close this ticket since I don't see the point to have it open.
Future update for this fix should come on release note for next versions. I will also try to contact you via teams chat if I have confirmation for the FW version that bring the fix.
